registryEntry.label: Assign Policy — Network Interfaces Should Not Have Public IPs (SB-1)
registryEntry.get_command: Get-AzPolicyAssignment -Name 'CES-No-NIC-Public-IP' -Scope '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroup}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, DisplayName, EnforcementMode | ConvertTo-Json
registryEntry.set_command: $a = Get-AzPolicyAssignment -Name 'CES-No-NIC-Public-IP' -Scope '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroup}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $a) { $def = Get-AzPolicyDefinition -Id '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/83a86a26-fd1f-447c-b59d-e51f44264114'; New-AzPolicyAssignment -Name 'CES-No-NIC-Public-IP' -DisplayName 'Network interfaces should not have public IPs (SB-1)' -PolicyDefinition $def -Scope '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroup}' | Select-Object Name,EnforcementMode | ConvertTo-Json } else { Write-Output 'Assignment already exists - skipping creation' }
